notes: REF-BM-05: no delete action anywhere; cards only offer archive/restore. REF-BM-10: existing tags are surfaced as clickable suggestion chips in the organize editor, but there is no as-you-type autocomplete on the new-tag input. REF-BM-15: boolean/parens work, but the boundary rule fails — quoting an operator ('AND') still tokenizes to type 'word' and isKeyword treats it as the operator, so operators cannot be quoted to become literal terms. REF-BM-20: no multi-select or bulk action UI/logic. REF-BM-21: no bulk-over-filter capability. REF-BM-22: no sort key/UI; list is fixed newest-first insertion order. REF-BM-24: no HTML/PDF snapshot feature. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-27: archive is reversible (restore) but permanent delete does not exist, so the archive-vs-delete distinction is incomplete. REF-BM-29: no bundles/saved filters. REF-BM-30: no Netscape HTML import. REF-BM-31: no export. REF-BM-32: no user settings (default sort, displayed items, font size).
